sharedContent.title: Correction, or no correction, that is the question. 2013 correction when the US government cracked down on Mt.Gox and seized accounts. 2017 corrections after Bitfinex hack, SEC ETF denial and BCH fork. Today Grayscale, Paypal, Cashapp each buy more BTC every day than are mined. https://t.co/m3A4RscRDI
sharedContent.author: PlanB

localize.full_text: 我想这个问题我们已经有答案了。https://t.co/1WOaWj9P5A
localize.quoted_status_full_text: 修正，还是不修正，这就是问题所在。更正2013年美国政府打击Mt.Gox并查封账户的情况。2017年在Bitfinex黑客攻击、SEC ETF拒绝和BCH分叉之后更正。今天，Grayscale，Paypal，Cashapp各自每天购买的BTC比开采的还要多。https://t.co/m3A4RscRDI
